name: Breakfast Cult
source:
By the year 209X, occult science has revolutionized the world. Much of it is thanks to the Foundation, a research institute devoted to everything from occultech to science education. Their greatest project is Occultar Academy, an island school where talented students learn sorcery under their watchful eye.

Breakfast Cult tells the story of "Pinky" Pinkerton, a returning student. A long time ago, Pinky was a fearsome delinquent who was expelled from Occultar for making too much trouble. Now that they've mellowed out, the Foundation has offered a second chance.

As Pinky, you'll get to know your classmates, learn the occult sciences, and try not to get kicked out again. With the Foundation's penchant for surveillance and the Headmaster breathing down Pinky's neck, it won't be easy. But that's not the real problem.

Occultar has secrets. The Foundation is up to something in the Forbidden Sections beneath the library. Outside forces are infiltrating the island. Even Pinky's classmates have skeletons they'll do anything to keep in the closet. Can Pinky unravel the mystery that links everything together and survive until graduation?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ettin/breakfast-cult-the-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
到209X年，神秘科学彻底改变了世界。这很大程度上要归功于基金会，这是一个致力于从神秘技术到科学教育等各个领域的研究机构。他们最伟大的项目是神秘学院，这是一所岛屿学校，有才华的学生在他们的注视下学习魔法。

《早餐崇拜》讲述了归国学生“粉红”平克顿的故事。很久以前，平基是一个可怕的不良少年，因为制造太多麻烦而被神秘学开除。现在他们已经成熟了，基金会提供了第二次机会。

作为Pinky，你将认识你的同学，学习神秘科学，并尽量不要再次被开除。鉴于基金会对监视的热衷以及校长对Pinky的监视，这并不容易。但这不是真正的问题。

神秘学有秘密。基金会正在图书馆地下的禁区里搞事情。外部势力正在渗透该岛。就连Pinky的同学也有他们愿意不惜一切代价将其隐藏起来的骷髅。Pinky能否解开将一切联系在一起的谜团并生存到毕业？

[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ettin/breakfast-cult-the-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url]]
